+        "add.rn.f32x2 p0, p0, k1;",
+        "add.rn.f32x2 p1, p1, k1;",
+        "mov.b64 {a0, a1}, p0;",
+        "mov.b64 {a2, a3}, p1;",
+        "rcp.approx.ftz.f32 a0, a0;",
+        "rcp.approx.ftz.f32 a1, a1;",
+        "rcp.approx.ftz.f32 a2, a2;",
+        "rcp.approx.ftz.f32 a3, a3;",
+        "cvt.rn.bf16x2.f32 w0, a1, a0;",
+        "cvt.rn.bf16x2.f32 w1, a3, a2;",
+        "mul.rn.bf16x2 $0, w0, $4;",
+        "mul.rn.bf16x2 $1, w1, $5;",
+        "}",
+    ]
+    return "\n".join(s)
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def gate_vec_exp_interleaved_default(gs, xs, b, *, loc=None, ip=None):
+    n = len(gs)
+    ops = [Uint32(v).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip) for v in gs + xs]
+    if b is not None:
+        ops.append(Uint32(b).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip))
+    res = _asm(
+        llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.i32()] * n),
+        ops,
+        _gate_vec_exp_interleaved_default_ptx(b is not None, n),
+        ",".join(["=r"] * n + ["r"] * len(ops)),
+        loc,
+        ip,
+    )
+    return [
+        Uint32(llvm.extractvalue(T.i32(), res, [i], loc=loc, ip=ip)) for i in range(n)
+    ]
+
+
+def _gate_vec_default_ptx(has_bias, npairs):
+    s = [
+        "{",
+        ".reg .b32 w, lo, hi;",
+        ".reg .b64 p, kl, k1;",
+        ".reg .f32 a0, a1;",
+        "mov.b64 kl, 0xBFB8AA3BBFB8AA3B;",
+        "mov.b64 k1, 0x3F8000003F800000;",
+    ]
+    for j in range(npairs):
+        g = f"${npairs + j}"
+        x = f"${2 * npairs + j}"
+        if has_bias:
+            s.append(f"add.rn.bf16x2 w, {g}, ${3 * npairs};")
+            g = "w"
+        s += [
+            f"shl.b32 lo, {g}, 16;",
+            f"and.b32 hi, {g}, 0xffff0000;",
+            "mov.b64 p, {lo, hi};",
+            "mul.rn.f32x2 p, p, kl;",
+            "mov.b64 {a0, a1}, p;",
+            "ex2.approx.ftz.f32 a0, a0;",
+            "ex2.approx.ftz.f32 a1, a1;",
+            "mov.b64 p, {a0, a1};",
+            "add.rn.f32x2 p, p, k1;",
+            "mov.b64 {a0, a1}, p;",
+            "rcp.approx.ftz.f32 a0, a0;",
+            "rcp.approx.ftz.f32 a1, a1;",
+            "cvt.rn.bf16x2.f32 w, a1, a0;",
+            f"mul.rn.bf16x2 ${j}, w, {x};",
+        ]
+    s.append("}")
+    return "\n".join(s)
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def gate_vec_default(gs, xs, b, *, loc=None, ip=None):
+    """Default-math (floor=0, temperature=1) gate for 2 or 4 packed BF16x2 pairs."""
+    n = len(gs)
+    ops = [Uint32(v).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip) for v in gs + xs]
+    if b is not None:
+        ops.append(Uint32(b).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip))
+    res = _asm(
+        llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.i32()] * n),
+        ops,
+        _gate_vec_default_ptx(b is not None, n),
+        ",".join(["=r"] * n + ["r"] * len(ops)),
+        loc,
+        ip,
+    )
+    return [
+        Uint32(llvm.extractvalue(T.i32(), res, [i], loc=loc, ip=ip)) for i in range(n)
+    ]
+
+
+def _gate_ptx_scalar(has_bias, has_temp, has_floor):
+    s = [
+        "{",
+        ".reg .b16 g, b, x, w;",
+        ".reg .f32 a, r;",
+        "cvt.u16.u32 g, $1;",
+        "cvt.u16.u32 x, $2;",
+    ]
+    w = "g"
+    if has_bias:
+        s += ["cvt.u16.u32 b, $3;", "add.rn.bf16 w, g, b;"]
+        w = "w"
+    if has_temp:
+        s += [
+            f"cvt.f32.bf16 a, {w};",
+            "div.full.f32 a, a, $4;",
+            "cvt.rn.bf16.f32 w, a;",
+        ]
+        w = "w"
+    s += [
+        f"cvt.f32.bf16 a, {w};",
+        "mul.rn.f32 a, a, 0fBFB8AA3B;",
+        "ex2.approx.ftz.f32 a, a;",
+        "add.rn.f32 a, a, 0f3F800000;",
+        "rcp.approx.ftz.f32 r, a;",
+        "cvt.rn.bf16.f32 w, r;",
+    ]
+    if has_floor:
+        s += [
+            "cvt.f32.bf16 a, w;",
+            "mul.rn.f32 a, a, $5;",
+            "cvt.rn.bf16.f32 w, a;",
+            "cvt.f32.bf16 a, w;",
+            "add.rn.f32 a, a, $6;",
+            "cvt.rn.bf16.f32 w, a;",
+        ]
+    s += ["mul.rn.bf16 w, w, x;", "mov.b32 $0, {w, w};", "}"]
+    return "\n".join(s)
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def gate_one(
+    g, x, b, temp, c1, flo, has_bias, has_temp, has_floor, *, loc=None, ip=None
+) -> Uint32:
+    ops = [
+        Uint32(g).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+        Uint32(x).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+        Uint32(b).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+        Float32(temp).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+        Float32(c1).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+        Float32(flo).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+    ]
+    return Uint32(
+        _asm(
+            T.i32(),
+            ops,
+            _gate_ptx_scalar(has_bias, has_temp, has_floor),
+            "=r,r,r,r,f,f,f",
+            loc,
+            ip,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def gate_one_default_bias(g, x, b, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> Uint32:
+    ops = [
+        Uint32(g).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+        Uint32(x).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+        Uint32(b).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+    ]
+    return Uint32(
+        _asm(T.i32(), ops, _gate_ptx_scalar(True, False, False), "=r,r,r,r", loc, ip)
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def gate_one_default_nobias(g, x, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> Uint32:
+    ops = [Uint32(g).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip), Uint32(x).ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)]
+    return Uint32(
+        _asm(T.i32(), ops, _gate_ptx_scalar(False, False, False), "=r,r,r", loc, ip)
+    )
+
+
+def gate_one_selected(g, x, b, temp, c1, flo, has_bias, has_temp, has_floor):
+    if const_expr(not has_temp and not has_floor):
+        if const_expr(has_bias):
+            return gate_one_default_bias(g, x, b)
+        return gate_one_default_nobias(g, x)
+    return gate_one(g, x, b, temp, c1, flo, has_bias, has_temp, has_floor)
+
+
+def _ld_words(addr, VEC, PF256):
+    if const_expr(VEC == 8):
+        return ld_v4(addr, ".L2::256B" if PF256 else "")
+    elif const_expr(VEC == 4):
+        return ld_v2(addr, ".L2::256B" if PF256 else ".L2::128B")
+    elif const_expr(VEC == 2):
+        return ld_b32(addr)
+    return [ld_b16_l2_128(addr, ".L2::256B" if PF256 else ".L2::128B")]
+
+
+@cute.kernel
+def _gate2d_kernel(
+    x_addr: Int64,
+    g_addr: Int64,
+    b_addr: Int64,
+    o_addr: Int64,
+    n_rows: Int32,
+    temp: Float32,
+    c1: Float32,
+    flo: Float32,
+    W: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    D: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    G_STRIDE: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    VEC: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    E: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    R: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    BLOCK: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    BIAS_MODE: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    HAS_TEMP: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    HAS_FLOOR: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    ROW_EXACT: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    ONE_ROW: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    ROWS_ON_X: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    PF256: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    INTERLEAVED8: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+    bx, by, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+    if const_expr(not ROWS_ON_X):
+        bx, by = by, bx
+    cta_cols = BLOCK * VEC * E
+    col_exact = W % cta_cols == 0
+    nwords = (VEC + 1) // 2
+    has_bias = BIAS_MODE != 0
+    row0 = Uint32(0) if const_expr(ONE_ROW) else Uint32(bx) * Uint32(R)
+    colbase = Uint32(by) * Uint32(cta_cols) + Uint32(tidx) * Uint32(VEC)
+
+    cols = []
+    colcs = []
+    bws = []
+    for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(E):
+        col = colbase + Uint32(e * BLOCK * VEC)
+        colc = col if const_expr(col_exact) else cutlass.min(col, Uint32(W - VEC))
+        cols.append(col)
+        colcs.append(colc)
+        if const_expr(BIAS_MODE == 1):
+            bw = [ld_bias_b16x2(b_addr + Int64(colc // Uint32(D)) * 2)] * nwords
+        elif const_expr(BIAS_MODE == 2):
+            bw = []
+            for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(nwords):
+                lo = ld_b16(b_addr + Int64((colc + Uint32(2 * j)) // Uint32(D)) * 2)
+                if const_expr(VEC > 1):
+                    hi = ld_b16(
+                        b_addr + Int64((colc + Uint32(2 * j + 1)) // Uint32(D)) * 2
+                    )
+                    bw.append(lo | (hi << 16))
+                else:
+                    bw.append(lo)
+        else:
+            bw = [Uint32(0)] * nwords
+        bws.append(bw)
+
+    rows = []
+    xs = []
+    gs = []
+    for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(R):
+        row = Uint32(0) if const_expr(ONE_ROW) else row0 + Uint32(r)
+        rowc = (
+            row
+            if const_expr(ONE_ROW or ROW_EXACT)
+            else cutlass.min(row, Uint32(n_rows) - Uint32(1))
+        )
+        rows.append(row)
+        if const_expr(ONE_ROW):
+            x_row = x_addr
+            g_row = g_addr
+        else:
+            x_row = x_addr + Int64(rowc) * (W * 2)
+            g_row = g_addr + Int64(rowc) * (G_STRIDE * 2)
+        xr = []
+        gr = []
+        for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(E):
+            xr.append(_ld_words(x_row + Int64(colcs[e]) * 2, VEC, PF256))
+            gr.append(_ld_words(g_row + Int64(colcs[e]) * 2, VEC, PF256))
+        xs.append(xr)
+        gs.append(gr)
+
+    outs = []
+    if const_expr(VEC == 1):
+        flat_g = []
+        flat_x = []
+        flat_b = []
+        for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(R):
+            for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(E):
+                flat_g.append(gs[r][e][0])
+                flat_x.append(xs[r][e][0])
+                flat_b.append(bws[e][0])
+        n = R * E
+        flat_o = []
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(0, n, 2):
+            if const_expr(i + 1 < n):
+                rr = gate_pair_selected(
+                    flat_g[i] | (flat_g[i + 1] << 16),
+                    flat_x[i] | (flat_x[i + 1] << 16),
+                    (flat_b[i] & Uint32(0xFFFF)) | (flat_b[i + 1] << 16),
+                    temp,
+                    c1,
+                    flo,
+                    has_bias,
+                    HAS_TEMP,
+                    HAS_FLOOR,
+                )
+                flat_o.append(rr)
+                flat_o.append(rr >> 16)
+            else:
+                flat_o.append(
+                    gate_one_selected(
+                        flat_g[i],
+                        flat_x[i],
+                        flat_b[i],
+                        temp,
+                        c1,
+                        flo,
+                        has_bias,
+                        HAS_TEMP,
+                        HAS_FLOOR,
+                    )
+                )
+        for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(R):
+            outs.append([[flat_o[r * E + e]] for e in range(E)])
+    else:
+        for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(R):
+            orow = []
+            for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(E):
+                if const_expr(
+                    VEC >= 4 and not HAS_TEMP and not HAS_FLOOR and BIAS_MODE == 1
+                ):
+                    if const_expr(VEC == 4):
+                        ow = gate_vec_exp_interleaved_default(
+                            gs[r][e], xs[r][e], bws[e][0]
+                        )
+                    elif const_expr(INTERLEAVED8):
+                        ow = gate_vec_exp_interleaved_default(
+                            gs[r][e][0:2], xs[r][e][0:2], bws[e][0]
+                        ) + gate_vec_exp_interleaved_default(
+                            gs[r][e][2:4], xs[r][e][2:4], bws[e][0]
+                        )
+                    else:
+                        ow = gate_vec_default(gs[r][e], xs[r][e], bws[e][0])
+                elif const_expr(
+                    VEC >= 4 and not HAS_TEMP and not HAS_FLOOR and BIAS_MODE == 0
+                ):
+                    if const_expr(VEC == 4):
+                        ow = gate_vec_exp_interleaved_default(gs[r][e], xs[r][e], None)
+                    elif const_expr(INTERLEAVED8):
+                        ow = gate_vec_exp_interleaved_default(
+                            gs[r][e][0:2], xs[r][e][0:2], None
+                        ) + gate_vec_exp_interleaved_default(
+                            gs[r][e][2:4], xs[r][e][2:4], None
+                        )
+                    else:
+                        ow = gate_vec_default(gs[r][e], xs[r][e], None)
+                else:
+                    ow = []
+                    for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(nwords):
+                        ow.append(
+                            gate_pair_selected(
+                                gs[r][e][j],
+                                xs[r][e][j],
+                                bws[e][j],
+                                temp,
+                                c1,
+                                flo,
+                                has_bias,
+                                HAS_TEMP,
+                                HAS_FLOOR,
+                            )
+                        )
+                orow.append(ow)
+            outs.append(orow)
+
+    st_pol = make_policy("evict_last") if const_expr(VEC == 8) else None
+    for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(R):
+        o_row = o_addr if const_expr(ONE_ROW) else o_addr + Int64(rows[r]) * (W * 2)
+        for e in cutlass.range_constexpr(E):
+            addr = o_row + Int64(cols[e]) * 2
+            if const_expr(ROW_EXACT and col_exact):
+                if const_expr(VEC == 1):
+                    st_b16(addr, outs[r][e][0])
+                elif const_expr(st_pol is not None):
+                    st_v4_hint(addr, outs[r][e], st_pol)
+                else:
+                    st_vec(addr, outs[r][e])
+            else:
+                if const_expr(ROW_EXACT):
+                    ok = cols[e] < Uint32(W)
+                elif const_expr(col_exact):
+                    ok = rows[r] < Uint32(n_rows)
+                else:
+                    ok = (rows[r] < Uint32(n_rows)) & (cols[e] < Uint32(W))
+                if ok:
+                    if const_expr(VEC == 1):
+                        st_b16(addr, outs[r][e][0])
+                    elif const_expr(st_pol is not None):
+                        st_v4_hint(addr, outs[r][e], st_pol)
+                    else:
+                        st_vec(addr, outs[r][e])
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _gate2d_launch(
+    x_addr: Int64,
+    g_addr: Int64,
+    b_addr: Int64,
+    o_addr: Int64,
+    n_rows: Int32,
+    temp: Float32,
+    c1: Float32,
+    flo: Float32,
+    stream: cuda.CUstream,
+    W: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    D: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    G_STRIDE: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    VEC: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    E: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    R: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    BLOCK: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    BIAS_MODE: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    HAS_TEMP: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    HAS_FLOOR: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    ROW_EXACT: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    ONE_ROW: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    ROWS_ON_X: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    CLUSTER_LAUNCH: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    PF256: cutlass.Constexpr,
+    INTERLEAVED8: cutlass.Constexpr,
+):
+    ncb = (W + BLOCK * VEC * E - 1) // (BLOCK * VEC * E)
+    nrb = (n_rows + (R - 1)) // R
+    grid = [nrb, ncb, 1] if const_expr(ROWS_ON_X) else [ncb, nrb, 1]
+    kernel = _gate2d_kernel(
+        x_addr,
+        g_addr,
+        b_addr,
+        o_addr,
+        n_rows,
+        temp,
+        c1,
+        flo,
+        W,
+        D,
+        G_STRIDE,
+        VEC,
+        E,
+        R,
+        BLOCK,
+        BIAS_MODE,
+        HAS_TEMP,
+        HAS_FLOOR,
+        ROW_EXACT,
+        ONE_ROW,
+        ROWS_ON_X,
+        PF256,
+        INTERLEAVED8,
+    )
+    # Small grids: launching as (trivial 1x1x1) clusters measured ~0.1 us lower end-to-
+    # end
+    # latency on B300, and adding the cooperative (co-resident) attribute on top of that
+    # a
+    # further 1-3 timer ticks; large grids lose CTA launch throughput this way.
+    if const_expr(CLUSTER_LAUNCH == 2):
+        kernel.launch(
+            grid=grid,
+            block=[BLOCK, 1, 1],
+            cluster=[1, 1, 1],
+            cooperative=True,
+            stream=stream,
+            preferred_smem_carveout=0,
+            min_blocks_per_mp=1,
+        )
+    elif const_expr(CLUSTER_LAUNCH == 1):
+        kernel.launch(
+            grid=grid,
+            block=[BLOCK, 1, 1],
+            cluster=[1, 1, 1],
+            stream=stream,
+            preferred_smem_carveout=0,
+        )
+    else:
+        kernel.launch(
+            grid=grid, block=[BLOCK, 1, 1], stream=stream, preferred_smem_carveout=0
+        )
+
+
+_cache: dict[tuple, Callable] = {}
+_no_coop = set()
+_CLUSTER_MAX_CTAS = 768
+# Cooperative 1x1x1-cluster launches were measured to be refused above ~1-1.5K CTAs on
+# B300
+# even when plain occupancy would allow more, so cap them here (and fall back if
+# refused).
+_COOP_MAX_CTAS = 1024
+_sm_count: list[int] = []
+
+
+def _num_sms():
+    if not _sm_count:
+        _sm_count.append(
+            torch.cuda.get_device_properties(
+                torch.accelerator.current_device_index()
+            ).multi_processor_count
+        )
+    return _sm_count[0]
+
+
+def _max_vec(W, gs, ptrs):
+    for vec in (8, 4, 2):
+        if W % vec == 0 and gs % vec == 0 and all(p % (2 * vec) == 0 for p in ptrs):
+            return vec
+    return 1
+
+
+def _coop_fits(ncta, block, regs):
+    """Conservative co-residency bound (no shared memory; regs rounded up per warp)."""
+    per_warp = -(-regs * 32 // 256) * 256
+    by_regs = 65536 // (per_warp * -(-block // 32))
+    per_sm = min(32, 2048 // block, by_regs)
+    return ncta <= min(_COOP_MAX_CTAS, _num_sms() * per_sm)
+
+
+def _choose(T_, W, maxvec, contiguous_gate):
+    """Return launch parameters and an optional cooperative register bound."""
+    n = T_ * W
+    if n <= 512 * 1024:
+        # Decode/small-prefill sizes (any floor/temperature). Scalar lanes in 96-ish
+        # CTAs
+        # up to 64K elements, then 8-byte packets with ~1.5-3K warps in flight.
+        pf256 = False
+        if n <= 16 * 1024:
+            vec, e, block_cap = 1, 1, 128
+        elif n <= 32 * 1024:
+            # A 256-thread scalar CTA spans 512 B: request 256 B per L2 miss.
+            vec, e, block_cap, pf256 = 1, 1, 256, True
+        elif n <= 64 * 1024:
+            # 512-thread scalar CTAs each cover 1 KB of a row: fetch 256 B per L2 miss.
+            vec, e, block_cap, pf256 = 1, 1, 512, True
+        elif n <= 128 * 1024:
+            vec, e, block_cap = 4, 1, 256
+        elif n <= 256 * 1024:
+            vec, e, block_cap = 4, 1, 512
+        else:
+            vec, e, block_cap = 4, 1, 384
+        vec = min(vec, maxvec)
+        if vec != 1:
+            pf256 = False
+        need = -(-W // (vec * e))
+        return vec, e, 1, min(block_cap, max(32, -(-need // 32) * 32)), pf256, None
+    if n <= 32 * 1024 * 1024:
+        vec, e, r = 8, 1, 1
+    else:
+        vec, e, r = 8, 1, 1 if contiguous_gate else 2
+    vec = min(vec, maxvec)
+    if vec == 8 and n > 1024 * 1024:
+        # Two rows per 192-thread CTA keep the T=512 primary grid co-resident.
+        ncb = -(-W // (192 * 8))
+        if ncb * 192 * 8 - W < 192 * 8 // 2 and _coop_fits(ncb * -(-T_ // 2), 192, 32):
+            return 8, 1, 2, 192, False, 32
+    need = -(-W // (vec * e))
+    block_cap = 256 if vec == 8 and 512 * 1024 <= n <= 1024 * 1024 else 128
+    if (
+        vec == 8
+        and n > 1024 * 1024
+        and -(-T_ // r) * -(-W // (256 * vec * e)) <= _CLUSTER_MAX_CTAS
+    ):
+        block_cap = 256  # keeps ~1-1.5M-element grids within the cluster-launch tier
+    block = min(block_cap, max(32, -(-need // 32) * 32))
+    return vec, e, r, block, False, None
+
+
+def run(attn_output, gate, gate_bias, num_heads, head_dim, floor, temperature, output):
+    T_ = attn_output.shape[0]

+"""DFlash2 draft model for Beam targets.
+
+A DFlash2 drafter predicts a block of tokens at once from hidden states the
+Beam target captures at `dflash_config.target_layer_ids`, then a low-rank
+candidate selector rescores the top-k tokens at each block position against
+the token before it. The drafter shares the target's embeddings and LM head.
+
+Nothing here is torch-compiled. The DFlash speculator captures the whole draft
+step (decoder layers, candidate head and selector) in its own CUDA graphs, and
+the context K/V precompute runs eagerly as a few fused kernels.
+"""

+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig, get_current_vllm_config
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.layernorm import RMSNorm
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.linear import ReplicatedLinear
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.logits_processor import LogitsProcessor
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.vocab_parallel_embedding import (
+    ParallelLMHead,
+    VocabParallelEmbedding,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.models.qwen3_dflash import DFlashQwen3Attention
+from vllm.model_executor.models.qwen3_dflash2 import DFlash2Qwen3DecoderLayer
+from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import (
+    AutoWeightsLoader,
+    WeightsMapper,
+    get_draft_quant_config,
+    maybe_prefix,
+)
+
+from .dflash2_ops import candidate_edges
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+
+class DFlash2BeamAttention(DFlashQwen3Attention):
+    def forward(
+        self, positions: torch.Tensor, hidden_states: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        from .attention_ops import beam_qk_norm_rope
+
+        qkv, _ = self.qkv_proj(hidden_states)
+        q, k, v = qkv.split([self.q_size, self.kv_size, self.kv_size], dim=-1)
+        if self.v_scale is not None:
+            v = v * self.v_scale
+        cache, slots = None, None
+        mapping = get_forward_context().slot_mapping
+        assert isinstance(mapping, dict)
+        if mapping and self.attn.kv_cache.dtype == q.dtype == torch.bfloat16:
+            slots = mapping[self.attn.layer_name]
+            cache = self.attn.kv_cache
+            assert self.attn.attn_backend.get_name() in ("FLASH_ATTN", "FLASHINFER")
+            assert self.attn.impl.dcp_world_size == 1
+            assert self.attn.kv_sharing_target_layer_name is None
+            assert cache.dtype == q.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+            assert cache.ndim == 4
+        rope = self.rotary_emb
+        q, k = beam_qk_norm_rope(
+            q,
+            k,
+            self.q_norm.weight,
+            self.k_norm.weight,
+            self.q_norm.variance_epsilon,
+            positions,
+            rope.cos_sin_cache,
+            self.head_dim,
+            rope.rotary_dim,
+            rope.is_neox_style,
+            value=v,
+            kv_cache=cache,
+            slot_mapping=slots,
+        )
+        output = self.attn(q, k, v) if cache is None else self.attn(q, None, None)
+        output, _ = self.o_proj(output)
+        return output
+
+
+class DFlash2BeamDecoderLayer(DFlash2Qwen3DecoderLayer):
+    attention_cls = DFlash2BeamAttention
+
+
+class DFlash2BeamCandidateSelector(nn.Module):
+    """Scores each candidate token against every candidate one position back.
+
+    For block position `p`, candidate `c` and predecessor `q`, the score is the
+    candidate's own logit plus `<predecessor[q] * h_p, successor[c]>`, where
+    `h_p` is the drafter's hidden state projected to the codebook rank. The
+    predecessor of the first position is the anchor token.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        vocab_size: int,
+        rank: int,
+        top_k: int,
+        params_dtype: torch.dtype,
+        prefix: str,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.top_k = top_k
+        self.predecessor_codebook = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.empty(vocab_size, rank, dtype=params_dtype), requires_grad=False
+        )
+        self.successor_codebook = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.empty(vocab_size, rank, dtype=params_dtype), requires_grad=False
+        )
+        self.hidden_projection = ReplicatedLinear(
+            hidden_size,
+            rank,
+            bias=False,
+            params_dtype=params_dtype,
+            quant_config=None,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "hidden_projection"),
+            return_bias=False,
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        candidate_ids: torch.Tensor,
+        unary_logits: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        anchor_token_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Edge scores `[requests, steps, top_k (predecessor), top_k]`."""
+        assert hidden_states.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        return candidate_edges(
+            self.predecessor_codebook,
+            self.successor_codebook,
+            candidate_ids,
+            unary_logits,
+            self.hidden_projection(hidden_states),
+            anchor_token_ids,
+            self.top_k,
+        )
+
+
+class DFlash2BeamModel(nn.Module):
+    hf_to_vllm_mapper = WeightsMapper(
+        orig_to_new_stacked={
+            ".q_proj": (".qkv_proj", "q"),
+            ".k_proj": (".qkv_proj", "k"),
+            ".v_proj": (".qkv_proj", "v"),
+            ".gate_proj": (".gate_up_proj", 0),
+            ".up_proj": (".gate_up_proj", 1),

+    )
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,

+    ) -> None:

+        assert vllm_config.speculative_config is not None
+        config = vllm_config.speculative_config.draft_model_config.hf_config
+        self.config = config
+        draft_config = config.dflash_config

+            vllm_config

+                "The Beam DFlash2 drafter supports only unquantized drafts "
+                "without attention biases."
+            )

+            draft_config.get("input_embedding_scale", 1.0)
+        )

+        self.embed_tokens = VocabParallelEmbedding(
+            config.vocab_size,
+            config.hidden_size,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "embed_tokens"),
+        )

+        # key the KV cache, do not collide with the target's.
+        current_vllm_config = get_current_vllm_config()
+        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
+            [
+                DFlash2BeamDecoderLayer(
+                    current_vllm_config,
+                    config=config,

+            target_hidden_size * len(draft_config["target_layer_ids"]),
+            config.hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            params_dtype=params_dtype,
+            quant_config=None,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "fc"),
+            return_bias=False,
+        )

+        self._context_cache_ptrs: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        self._context_scale_ptrs: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        self._context_cache_addresses: tuple[int, ...] | None = None
+        self.norm = RMSNorm(config.hidden_size, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.candidate_selector = DFlash2BeamCandidateSelector(
+            hidden_size=config.hidden_size,
+            vocab_size=config.vocab_size,
+            rank=int(draft_config["selector_rank"]),
+            top_k=int(draft_config["selector_top_k"]),
+            params_dtype=params_dtype,
+            prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "candidate_selector"),

+    def embed_input_ids(self, input_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        embeds = self.embed_tokens(input_ids)

+            embeds = embeds * self.input_embedding_scale

+    def build_context_kv_weights(self) -> None:

+            [attn.qkv_proj.weight[attn.q_size :] for attn in attns]

+        hidden_states,
+        coefficients,
+        layer.attention_conv.base_kernel[1],
+        residual,
+        layer.post_attention_layernorm.weight,
+        layer.post_attention_layernorm.variance_epsilon,
+        layer.attention_conv.block_size,
+        layer.attention_conv.group_size,
+    )

+    hidden_states = layer.mlp(hidden_states)
+    return conv_residual_norm(
+        hidden_states,
+        coefficients,
+        layer.mlp_conv.base_kernel[1],
+        residual,
+        next_norm.weight,
+        next_norm.variance_epsilon,
+        layer.mlp_conv.block_size,
+        layer.mlp_conv.group_size,
+    )

+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["ROWS", "NUM_SLOTS"])
+def _context_kv_kernel(
+    KV,
+    WEIGHT,
+    POSITIONS,
+    ROPE,
+    CACHE_PTRS,
+    CACHE,
+    SCALE_PTRS,
+    SLOTS,
+    ROWS,
+    NUM_SLOTS,
+    LAYERS: tl.constexpr,
+    HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    HEAD_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    TOKEN_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    PAGE: tl.constexpr,
+    EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    VALUE_SCALE: tl.constexpr,
+    NEOX: tl.constexpr,
+    FP8: tl.constexpr,
+    FP8_MAX: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64) * 4 + tl.arange(0, 4)
+    layer_head = tl.program_id(1)
+    layer = layer_head // HEADS
+    head = layer_head % HEADS
+    col = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    slot = tl.load(SLOTS + row, (row < ROWS) & (row < NUM_SLOTS), -1).to(tl.int64)
+    mask = (row[:, None] < ROWS) & (slot[:, None] >= 0) & (col[None, :] < DIM)
+    offsets = (
+        row[:, None] * (LAYERS * 2 * HEADS * DIM)
+        + (layer * 2 * HEADS + head) * DIM
+        + col[None, :]
+    )
+    key = tl.load(KV + offsets, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    if BLOCK == 128:
+        squares = (key * key).reshape((4, 4, 32))
+        total = tl.sum(tl.sum(squares, 2), 1)
+    else:
+        total = tl.sum(key * key, 1)
+    weight = tl.load(WEIGHT + layer * DIM + col, col < DIM, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    key = key * tl.rsqrt(total / DIM + EPS)[:, None] * weight[None, :]
+    key = key.to(KV.dtype.element_ty).to(tl.float32)
+    half: tl.constexpr = DIM // 2
+    if NEOX:
+        partner = (col + half) % DIM
+        second = col >= half
+        rope_col = col % half
+    else:
+        partner = col ^ 1
+        second = col % 2 != 0
+        rope_col = col // 2
+    other = tl.gather(key, tl.broadcast_to(partner[None, :], (4, BLOCK)), 1)
+    position = tl.load(POSITIONS + row, (row < ROWS) & (slot >= 0), 0).to(tl.int64)
+    cosine = tl.load(ROPE + position[:, None] * DIM + rope_col[None, :], mask, 0)
+    sine = tl.load(ROPE + position[:, None] * DIM + half + rope_col[None, :], mask, 0)
+    key = tl.where(
+        second[None, :],
+        tl.fma(other, sine, key * cosine),
+        tl.fma(key, cosine, -other * sine),
+    )
+    cache = tl.load(CACHE_PTRS + layer).to(tl.pointer_type(CACHE.dtype.element_ty))
+    address = (
+        slot[:, None] // PAGE * BLOCK_STRIDE
+        + slot[:, None] % PAGE * TOKEN_STRIDE
+        + head * HEAD_STRIDE
+        + col[None, :]
+    )
+    value = tl.load(KV + offsets + HEADS * DIM, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    value = value * VALUE_SCALE
+    if FP8:
+        # Preserve BF16 rounding after RoPE and value scaling.
+        key = key.to(KV.dtype.element_ty).to(tl.float32)
+        value = value.to(KV.dtype.element_ty).to(tl.float32)
+        k_scale = tl.load(SCALE_PTRS + layer * 2).to(tl.pointer_type(tl.float32))
+        v_scale = tl.load(SCALE_PTRS + layer * 2 + 1).to(tl.pointer_type(tl.float32))
+        key = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(key / tl.load(k_scale), -FP8_MAX), FP8_MAX)
+        value = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(value / tl.load(v_scale), -FP8_MAX), FP8_MAX)
+    tl.store(cache + address, key, mask)
+    tl.store(cache + address + DIM, value, mask)
+
+
+def store_context_kv(
+    kv: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    rope: torch.Tensor,
+    cache_ptrs: torch.Tensor,
+    slots: torch.Tensor,
+    cache: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+    value_scale: float,
+    is_neox: bool,
+    scale_ptrs: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> None:
+    """Normalize, rotate, and scatter all draft layers' context K/V."""
+    rows, layers, _, heads, dim = kv.shape
+    fp8 = cache.dtype in (torch.float8_e4m3fn, torch.float8_e5m2)
+    assert cache.dtype == kv.dtype or fp8
+    assert not fp8 or scale_ptrs is not None
+    if rows:
+        _context_kv_kernel[(triton.cdiv(rows, 4), layers * heads)](
+            kv,
+            weight,
+            positions,
+            rope,
+            cache_ptrs,
+            cache,
+            scale_ptrs,
+            slots,
+            rows,
+            slots.numel(),
+            layers,
+            heads,
+            dim,
+            cache.stride(0),
+            cache.stride(1),
+            cache.stride(2),
+            cache.shape[2],
+            eps,
+            value_scale,
+            is_neox,
+            fp8,
+            torch.finfo(cache.dtype).max if fp8 else 0.0,
+            triton.next_power_of_2(dim),
+            num_warps=4,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )

+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _conv_residual_norm_kernel(
+    X,
+    DELTA,
+    BASE,
+    RESIDUAL,
+    WEIGHT,
+    OUTPUT,
+    X_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    DELTA_ROW_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    DELTA_TAP_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    RESIDUAL_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+    GROUP: tl.constexpr,
+    TAPS: tl.constexpr,
+    QUERY: tl.constexpr,
+    EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    col = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = col < WIDTH
+    group = col // GROUP
+    coefficient = tl.load(BASE + col, mask, 0).to(tl.float32) + tl.load(
+        DELTA + row * DELTA_ROW_STRIDE + group, mask, 0
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    value = tl.load(X + row * X_STRIDE + col, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    result = coefficient * value
+    for tap in tl.static_range(1, TAPS):
+        valid = mask & (row % QUERY >= tap)
+        coefficient = tl.load(BASE + tap * WIDTH + col, valid, 0).to(
+            tl.float32
+        ) + tl.load(
+            DELTA + row * DELTA_ROW_STRIDE + tap * DELTA_TAP_STRIDE + group, valid, 0
+        ).to(tl.float32)
+        value = tl.load(X + (row - tap) * X_STRIDE + col, valid, 0).to(tl.float32)
+        result = tl.fma(coefficient, value, result)
+    result = result.to(X.dtype.element_ty).to(tl.float32)
+    residual = tl.load(RESIDUAL + row * RESIDUAL_STRIDE + col, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    result = (result + residual).to(RESIDUAL.dtype.element_ty).to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(RESIDUAL + row * RESIDUAL_STRIDE + col, result, mask)
+    variance = tl.sum(result * result, 0) / WIDTH
+    weight = tl.load(WEIGHT + col, mask, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    normalized = result * tl.rsqrt(variance + EPS) * weight
+    tl.store(OUTPUT + row * WIDTH + col, normalized, mask)
+
+
+def conv_residual_norm(
+    hidden: torch.Tensor,
+    coefficients: torch.Tensor,
+    base: torch.Tensor,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    weight: torch.Tensor,
+    eps: float,
+    query_len: int,
+    group_size: int,
+    *,
+    num_warps: int | None = None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Finish grouped convolution and update the residual before RMSNorm."""
+    rows, width = hidden.shape
+    if num_warps is None:
+        num_warps = 16 if rows <= 256 else (8 if rows < 4096 else 4)
+    output = torch.empty_like(hidden)
+    if rows:
+        _conv_residual_norm_kernel[(rows,)](
+            hidden,
+            coefficients,
+            base,
+            residual,
+            weight,
+            output,
+            hidden.stride(0),
+            coefficients.stride(0),
+            coefficients.stride(1),
+            residual.stride(0),
+            width,
+            group_size,
+            base.shape[0],
+            query_len,
+            eps,
+            triton.next_power_of_2(width),
+            num_warps=num_warps,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+    return output, residual

+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _candidate_edges_kernel(
+    PREDECESSORS,
+    SUCCESSORS,
+    IDS,
+    UNARY,
+    HIDDEN,
+    ANCHORS,
+    OUTPUT,
+    ANCHOR_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    STEPS: tl.constexpr,
+    TOP_K: tl.constexpr,
+    RANK: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK_R: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    position = tl.program_id(0)
+    predecessor = tl.program_id(1)
+    step = position % STEPS
+    if step == 0:
+        pred_id = tl.load(ANCHORS + position // STEPS * ANCHOR_STRIDE).to(tl.int64)
+    else:
+        pred_id = tl.load(IDS + (position - 1) * TOP_K + predecessor).to(tl.int64)
+    r = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_R)
+    c = tl.arange(0, BLOCK_K)
+    pred = tl.load(PREDECESSORS + pred_id.to(tl.int64) * RANK + r, r < RANK, 0)
+    hidden = tl.load(HIDDEN + position * RANK + r, r < RANK, 0)
+    # Preserve the materialized product and GEMM's output rounding.
+    weighted = (pred.to(tl.float32) * hidden.to(tl.float32)).to(hidden.dtype)
+    ids = tl.load(IDS + position * TOP_K + c, c < TOP_K, 0).to(tl.int64)
+    successors = tl.load(
+        SUCCESSORS + ids[:, None] * RANK + r[None, :],
+        (c[:, None] < TOP_K) & (r[None, :] < RANK),
+        0,
+    )
+    scores = tl.sum(successors.to(tl.float32) * weighted[None, :].to(tl.float32), 1)
+    scores = scores.to(hidden.dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    unary = tl.load(UNARY + position * TOP_K + c, c < TOP_K, 0).to(tl.float32)
+    tl.store(
+        OUTPUT + (position * TOP_K + predecessor) * TOP_K + c, scores + unary, c < TOP_K
+    )
+
+
+def candidate_edges(
+    predecessor_table: torch.Tensor,
+    successor_table: torch.Tensor,
+    candidate_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    unary_logits: torch.Tensor,
+    hidden: torch.Tensor,
+    anchor_token_ids: torch.Tensor,
+    top_k: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Gather codebooks and score candidate edges without intermediate tensors."""
+    batch, steps, _ = candidate_ids.shape
+    rank = hidden.shape[-1]
+    output = torch.empty(
+        (batch, steps, top_k, top_k), dtype=unary_logits.dtype, device=hidden.device
+    )
+    if batch * steps:
+        _candidate_edges_kernel[(batch * steps, top_k)](
+            predecessor_table,
+            successor_table,
+            candidate_ids,
+            unary_logits,
+            hidden,
+            anchor_token_ids,
+            output,
+            anchor_token_ids.stride(0),
+            steps,
+            top_k,
+            rank,
+            triton.next_power_of_2(top_k),
+            triton.next_power_of_2(rank),
+            num_warps=4,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+        )
+    return output

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""Beam kernels preserving FP32 normalization and affine arithmetic."""
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+class RMSNorm(nn.Module):
+    """Parameters for normalization performed directly by the model kernels."""
+
+    def __init__(self, hidden_size: int, has_weight: bool = True) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(hidden_size)) if has_weight else None
+
+    def forward(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        raise RuntimeError("Call the model's fused normalization kernels directly")
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _rms_norm_kernel(
+    X,
+    W,
+    Y,
+    N: tl.constexpr,
+    HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    STRIDE_TOKEN: tl.constexpr,
+    STRIDE_HEAD: tl.constexpr,
+    EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    HAS_WEIGHT: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    idx = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    token = row // HEADS
+    head = row % HEADS
+    x = tl.load(
+        X + token * STRIDE_TOKEN + head * STRIDE_HEAD + idx, idx < N, other=0
+    ).to(tl.float32)
+    mean = tl.sum(x * x, 0) / N
+    y = x * tl.rsqrt(mean + EPS)
+    if HAS_WEIGHT:
+        w = tl.load(W + idx, idx < N, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+        y = y * w
+    tl.store(Y + row * N + idx, y, idx < N)
+
+
+def beam_rms_norm(
+    x: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor | None, eps: float
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Normalize strided token/head rows, rounding only after the affine multiply."""
+    assert x.ndim in (2, 3) and x.stride(-1) == 1
+    n = x.shape[-1]
+    heads = x.shape[1] if x.ndim == 3 else 1
+    out = torch.empty(x.shape, device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
+    if out.numel() == 0:
+        return out
+    _rms_norm_kernel[(x.numel() // n,)](
+        x,
+        weight,
+        out,
+        n,
+        heads,
+        x.stride(0),
+        x.stride(-2) if x.ndim == 3 else n,
+        eps,
+        weight is not None,
+        triton.next_power_of_2(n),
+        num_warps=4 if n <= 1024 else 8,
+        enable_fp_fusion=False,
+    )
+    return out
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _boundary_math(
+    x,
+    r,
+    POST_W,
+    NEXT_W,
+    col,
+    dtype: tl.constexpr,
+    N: tl.constexpr,
+    POST_EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    NEXT_EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    X_SCALE,
+    R_SCALE,
+    POST_NORM: tl.constexpr,
+    POST_WEIGHT: tl.constexpr,
+    NEXT_NORM: tl.constexpr,
+    NEXT_WEIGHT: tl.constexpr,
+    SCALED: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    if POST_NORM:
+        x = x * tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(x * x, 0) / N + POST_EPS)
+        if POST_WEIGHT:
+            w = tl.load(POST_W + col, col < N, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+            x = x * w
+        x = x.to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    if SCALED:
+        x = (x * X_SCALE).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+        r = (r * R_SCALE).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    h = (x + r).to(dtype)
+    if NEXT_NORM:
+        h_fp32 = tl.where(col < N, h.to(tl.float32), 0)
+        y = h_fp32 * tl.rsqrt(tl.sum(h_fp32 * h_fp32, 0) / N + NEXT_EPS)
+        if NEXT_WEIGHT:
+            w = tl.load(NEXT_W + col, col < N, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+            y = y * w
+    else:
+        y = h
+    return h, y
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _norm_residual_norm_kernel(
+    X,
+    R,
+    POST_W,
+    NEXT_W,
+    H,
+    Y,
+    N: tl.constexpr,
+    X_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    R_STRIDE: tl.constexpr,
+    POST_EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    NEXT_EPS: tl.constexpr,
+    X_SCALE,
+    R_SCALE,
+    POST_NORM: tl.constexpr,
+    POST_WEIGHT: tl.constexpr,
+    NEXT_NORM: tl.constexpr,
+    NEXT_WEIGHT: tl.constexpr,
+    SCALED: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+    PDL: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    col = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    dtype = X.dtype.element_ty
+    if PDL:
+        tl.extra.cuda.gdc_wait()
+    x = tl.load(X + row * X_STRIDE + col, col < N, other=0).to(tl.float32)
+    r = tl.load(R + row * R_STRIDE + col, col < N, other=0).to(dtype).to(tl.float32)
+    h, y = _boundary_math(
+        x,
+        r,
+        POST_W,
+        NEXT_W,
+        col,
+        dtype,
+        N,
+        POST_EPS,
+        NEXT_EPS,
+        X_SCALE,
+        R_SCALE,
+        POST_NORM,
+        POST_WEIGHT,
+        NEXT_NORM,
+        NEXT_WEIGHT,
+        SCALED,
+    )
+    tl.store(H + row * N + col, h, col < N)
+    if NEXT_NORM:
+        tl.store(Y + row * N + col, y, col < N)
+
+
+def beam_norm_residual_norm(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    post_weight: torch.Tensor | None,
+    post_eps: float | None,
+    next_weight: torch.Tensor | None,
+    next_eps: float | None,
+    scales: tuple[float, float] | None,
+    *,
+    launch_pdl: bool = False,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
+    """Fuse post-norm, scaled residual add and next pre-norm, keeping each cast."""
+    assert x.ndim == residual.ndim == 2 and x.shape == residual.shape
+    assert x.stride(-1) == residual.stride(-1) == 1
+    hidden = torch.empty(x.shape, device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
+    normalized = torch.empty_like(hidden) if next_eps is not None else None
+    n = x.shape[-1]
+    if hidden.numel():
+        _norm_residual_norm_kernel[(x.shape[0],)](
+            x,
+            residual,
+            post_weight,
+            next_weight,
+            hidden,
+            normalized,
+            n,
+            x.stride(0),
+            residual.stride(0),
+            post_eps or 0.0,
+            next_eps or 0.0,
+            *(scales if scales is not None else (1.0, 1.0)),
+            post_eps is not None,
+            post_weight is not None,
+            next_eps is not None,
+            next_weight is not None,
+            scales is not None,
+            triton.next_power_of_2(n),
+            launch_pdl,
+            num_warps=4 if launch_pdl or n <= 1024 else 8,
+            enable_fp_fusion=False,
+            launch_pdl=launch_pdl,
+        )
+    return hidden, normalized

+def _depth_scaled_coeffs(layer_id: int, is_attention: bool) -> tuple[float, float]:

+class BeamDecoderLayer(nn.Module):

+    def __init__(

+        quant_config = vllm_config.quant_config

+            allreduce_workspace is not None and not config.attention_bias

+            cache_config,
+            quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.self_attn",
+            reduce_results=not fuse_attention_reduce,
+        )

+            self.mlp: nn.Module = BeamMLP(
+                hidden_size=config.hidden_size,
+                intermediate_size=config.intermediate_size,
+                hidden_act=config.hidden_act,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.mlp",
+                reduce_results=allreduce_workspace is None,
+            )
+        else:
+            self.mlp = BeamSparseMoeBlock(
+                vllm_config=vllm_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.mlp",
+                reduce_results=allreduce_workspace is None,
+            )
+
+        fused_boundary = (
+            partial(beam_allreduce_norm_residual_norm, workspace=allreduce_workspace)
+            if allreduce_workspace is not None
+            else beam_norm_residual_norm
+        )
+        self.attention_boundary = (
+            fused_boundary if fuse_attention_reduce else beam_norm_residual_norm
+        )
+        fuse_mlp_reduce = allreduce_workspace is not None and (
+            isinstance(self.mlp, BeamMLP)

+                not self.mlp.is_sequence_parallel
+                and self.mlp.experts.moe_config.skip_final_all_reduce
+            )
+        )
+        self.mlp_boundary = (
+            fused_boundary if fuse_mlp_reduce else beam_norm_residual_norm
+        )
+        self.finalize_boundary = None
+        if fuse_mlp_reduce and isinstance(self.mlp, BeamSparseMoeBlock):

+            moe_config = self.mlp.experts.moe_config

+                routed_scale=self.mlp.experts.routed_scaling_factor,

+        self.pre_feedforward_layernorm = RMSNorm(config.hidden_size)
+        self.post_attention_layernorm = (
+            RMSNorm(config.hidden_size) if config.enable_sandwich_norm else None

+        self.post_feedforward_layernorm = (
+            RMSNorm(config.hidden_size) if config.enable_sandwich_norm else None

+            self.rms_norm_eps,

+    def forward(
+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        normalized_states: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        next_norm_weight: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
+        x = (
+            beam_rms_norm(hidden_states, self.input_layernorm.weight, self.rms_norm_eps)

+            else normalized_states
+        )
+        x = self.self_attn(positions, x)
+        hidden_states, x = self.attention_boundary(
+            x,
+            hidden_states,
+            self.post_attention_layernorm.weight
+            if self.post_attention_layernorm is not None
+            else None,
+            self.rms_norm_eps if self.post_attention_layernorm is not None else None,

+                hidden_states,
+                self.post_feedforward_layernorm.weight

+                self.rms_norm_eps
+                if self.post_feedforward_layernorm is not None

+            hidden_states,
+            self.post_feedforward_layernorm.weight
+            if self.post_feedforward_layernorm is not None
+            and not self.mlp_post_norm_fused
+            else None,
+            self.rms_norm_eps
+            if self.post_feedforward_layernorm is not None
+            and not self.mlp_post_norm_fused
+            else None,
+            next_norm_weight,
+            self.rms_norm_eps if next_norm_weight is not None else None,
+            self.mlp_scales,

+def _beam_moe_forward_boundary(
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    post_weight: torch.Tensor | None,
+    post_eps: float | None,
+    next_weight: torch.Tensor | None,
+    next_eps: float | None,
+    x_scale: float | None,
+    r_scale: float | None,
+    layer_name: _layer_name_type,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    experts = get_layer_from_name(_resolve_layer_name(layer_name))
+    layer = get_forward_context().no_compile_layers[f"{experts.layer_name}.finalize"]
+    assert isinstance(layer, BeamSparseMoeBlock)
+    hidden, normalized = layer._forward_boundary(
+        hidden_states,
+        residual,
+        post_weight,
+        post_eps,
+        next_weight,
+        next_eps,
+        (x_scale, r_scale) if x_scale is not None and r_scale is not None else None,
+    )
+    return hidden, normalized if normalized is not None else residual.new_empty(0)

+def _beam_moe_forward_boundary_fake(
+    hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,

+    next_weight: torch.Tensor | None,
+    next_eps: float | None,
+    x_scale: float | None,
+    r_scale: float | None,
+    layer_name: _layer_name_type,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:

+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        gate_up, _ = self.gate_up_proj(x)
+        # Beam rounds once after the fp32 SiLU and gate/up multiplication.
+        out = beam_silu_mul(gate_up)
+        out, _ = self.down_proj(out)
+        return out
+
+
+class BeamSparseMoeBlock(nn.Module):

+

+            topk_group=config.topk_group,

+                config.routed_scaling_factor

+            apply_routed_scale_to_output=True,

+            enable_eplb=parallel_config.enable_eplb,

+
+    def defer_finalize(self, max_tokens: int, *, allow_ep: bool = False) -> None:
+        from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.experts.trtllm_nvfp4_moe import (

+            or not 1 <= moe.experts_per_token <= 32

+    def forward_boundary(

+    def _forward_boundary(

+        from .moe_finalize import (

+        num_tokens = hidden_states.shape[0]
+        if self.is_sequence_parallel:
+            hidden_states = sequence_parallel_chunk(hidden_states)
+        elif self.experts.moe_config.should_defer_moe_finalize(num_tokens):
+            output = self.experts._forward_impl(hidden_states, hidden_states, None)
+            assert isinstance(output, UnfinalizedMoEOutput)
+            return output
+
+        output = self.experts(hidden_states=hidden_states, router_logits=hidden_states)
+        if self.is_sequence_parallel:
+            output = tensor_model_parallel_all_gather(output, 0)[:num_tokens]

+"""Finalize live MegaMoE tokens with Beam's post normalization."""
+
+import functools
+import hashlib
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.moe_output import UnfinalizedMoEOutput
+
+from .allreduce import BeamAllReduceWorkspace
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def _module(packs_per_thread: int = 1):
+    from flashinfer.jit import env as jit_env
+    from flashinfer.jit.core import current_compilation_context, gen_jit_spec
+
+    source = Path(__file__).with_suffix(".cu")
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()[:16]
+    flags = current_compilation_context.get_nvcc_flags_list(
+        supported_major_versions=[9, 10]
+    )
+    spec = gen_jit_spec(
+        f"beam_moe_finalize_{digest}_{packs_per_thread}",
+        [source],
+        extra_cuda_cflags=[
+            *flags,
+            "--fmad=false",
+            f"-DBEAM_MOE_PACKS_PER_THREAD={packs_per_thread}",
+        ],
+        extra_include_paths=[jit_env.FLASHINFER_CSRC_DIR],
+    )
+    spec.extra_cuda_cflags.remove("-use_fast_math")
+    return spec.build_and_load()
+
+
+def beam_moe_finalize(
+    expert_outputs: torch.Tensor,
+    expert_weights: torch.Tensor,
+    output: torch.Tensor,
+    routed_scale: float = 1.0,
+    post_weight: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    post_eps: float | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Reduce only output rows, preserving BF16 casts before scale and RMSNorm.
+
+    Args:
+        expert_outputs: Contiguous BF16 expert results [capacity, top_k, hidden].
+        expert_weights: Contiguous FP32 routing weights [capacity, top_k].
+        output: Contiguous BF16 destination [live_tokens, hidden].
+        routed_scale: Multiplier applied after rounding the expert reduction.
+        post_weight: Optional BF16 RMSNorm affine weight [hidden].
+        post_eps: RMSNorm epsilon, or None to omit normalization.
+
+    """
+    assert expert_outputs.ndim == 3 and expert_weights.ndim == output.ndim == 2
+    capacity, top_k, hidden = expert_outputs.shape
+    assert 1 <= top_k <= 32
+    assert 256 <= hidden <= 8192 and hidden % 256 == 0
+    assert output.shape[1] == hidden and output.shape[0] <= capacity
+    assert expert_weights.shape[1] == top_k
+    assert expert_weights.shape[0] >= output.shape[0]
+    assert expert_outputs.dtype == output.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+    assert expert_weights.dtype == torch.float32
+    assert output.is_cuda
+    for tensor in (expert_outputs, expert_weights, output):
+        assert tensor.is_contiguous() and tensor.device == output.device
+    if post_weight is not None:
+        assert post_eps is not None
+        assert post_weight.shape == (hidden,) and post_weight.is_contiguous()
+        assert post_weight.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        assert post_weight.device == output.device
+    if output.shape[0]:
+        _module().beam_moe_finalize(
+            expert_outputs,
+            expert_weights,
+            output,
+            post_weight,
+            routed_scale,
+            post_eps or 0.0,
+            post_eps is not None,
+        )
+    return output
+
+
+def beam_moe_finalize_gather_norm_residual_norm(
+    x: UnfinalizedMoEOutput,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    post_weight: torch.Tensor | None,
+    post_eps: float | None,
+    next_weight: torch.Tensor | None,
+    next_eps: float | None,
+    scales: tuple[float, float] | None,
+    workspace: BeamAllReduceWorkspace,
+    routed_scale: float = 1.0,
+    *,
+    strategy: str | None = None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
+    """Finalize MegaMoE output and restore the replicated token boundary.
+
+    FlashInfer's ``forward_unfinalized`` guarantees token-major expert rows and
+    an identity route map, so a view recovers its [tokens, top_k, hidden] layout.
+    This consumer requires that producer contract.
+
+    Each rank owns ceil(global_tokens / TP) consecutive tokens. Capacity rows
+    and the final rank's token padding do not contribute to the returned tensors.
+    ``strategy`` overrides the token-count heuristic for validation and benchmarking.
+    """
+    assert residual.ndim == 2 and residual.is_cuda
+    tokens, hidden_size = residual.shape
+    local_tokens = (tokens + workspace.world_size - 1) // workspace.world_size
+    assert tokens <= workspace.max_tokens and hidden_size == workspace.hidden_size
+    expert_weights = x.expert_weights
+    assert expert_weights.ndim == 2
+    assert x.gemm2_permuted.ndim == 2 and x.gemm2_permuted.is_contiguous()
+    assert x.gemm2_permuted.shape[1] == hidden_size
+    expert_outputs = x.gemm2_permuted.view(*expert_weights.shape, hidden_size)
+    assert expert_weights.shape[0] >= local_tokens
+    assert 1 <= expert_weights.shape[1] <= 32
+    assert expert_outputs.dtype == residual.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+    assert expert_weights.dtype == torch.float32
+    for tensor in (expert_outputs, expert_weights, residual):
+        assert tensor.is_contiguous() and tensor.device == residual.device
+    for weight, eps in ((post_weight, post_eps), (next_weight, next_eps)):
+        if weight is not None:
+            assert eps is not None
+            assert weight.shape == (hidden_size,) and weight.is_contiguous()
+            assert weight.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and weight.device == residual.device
+    if strategy is None:
+        if tokens <= workspace.moe_gather_oneshot_max_tokens:
+            strategy = "oneshot"
+        elif (
+            workspace.moe_gather_separate_norm_min_tokens is not None
+            and tokens >= workspace.moe_gather_separate_norm_min_tokens
+        ):
+            strategy = "unfused"
+        else:
+            strategy = "twoshot"
+    if strategy not in ("unfused", "oneshot", "twoshot"):
+        raise ValueError(f"Unknown MegaMoE gather strategy: {strategy}")
+    if not tokens:
+        hidden = torch.empty_like(residual)
+        return hidden, torch.empty_like(residual) if next_eps is not None else None
+    if strategy == "unfused":
+        from .layernorm import beam_norm_residual_norm
+
+        local = torch.empty(
+            (local_tokens, hidden_size), dtype=residual.dtype, device=residual.device
+        )
+        beam_moe_finalize(
+            expert_outputs, expert_weights, local, routed_scale, post_weight, post_eps
+        )
+        if workspace.all_gather is not None:
+            gathered = workspace.all_gather(local)
+        else:
+            gathered = torch.empty(
+                (local_tokens * workspace.world_size, hidden_size),
+                dtype=residual.dtype,
+                device=residual.device,
+            )
+            torch.distributed.all_gather_into_tensor(
+                gathered, local, group=workspace.device_group
+            )
+        return beam_norm_residual_norm(
+            gathered[:tokens], residual, None, None, next_weight, next_eps, scales
+        )
+    hidden = torch.empty_like(residual)
+    normalized = torch.empty_like(residual) if next_eps is not None else None
+    w = workspace.workspace
+    workspace.module.beam_moe_gather(
+        expert_outputs,
+        expert_weights,
+        residual,
+        post_weight,
+        next_weight,
+        hidden,
+        normalized,
+        w.uc_ptrs_dev,
+        w.buffer_flags,
+        w.mc_ptr,
+        w.uc_ptr_local,
+        workspace.world_size,
+        workspace.rank,
+        post_eps or 0.0,
+        next_eps or 0.0,
+        *(scales if scales is not None else (1.0, 1.0)),
+        post_eps is not None,
+        next_eps is not None,
+        scales is not None,
+        strategy == "oneshot",
+        routed_scale,
+    )
+    return hidden, normalized
+
+
+def beam_moe_finalize_norm_residual_norm(
+    x: UnfinalizedMoEOutput,
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    post_weight: torch.Tensor | None,
+    post_eps: float | None,
+    next_weight: torch.Tensor | None,
+    next_eps: float | None,
+    scales: tuple[float, float] | None,
+    routed_scale: float = 1.0,
+    *,
+    strategy: str | None = None,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor | None]:
+    """Finalize local MegaMoE tokens through the next normalization boundary.
+
+    Requires FlashInfer's token-major expert rows and identity route map.
+    Only the live rows in ``residual`` are read from the workspace capacity.
+    ``strategy`` can force the unfused reference for validation and benchmarking.
+    """
+    assert residual.ndim == 2 and residual.is_cuda
+    tokens, hidden_size = residual.shape
+    assert 256 <= hidden_size <= 8192 and hidden_size % 256 == 0
+    expert_weights = x.expert_weights
+    assert expert_weights.ndim == 2 and expert_weights.shape[0] >= tokens
+    assert 1 <= expert_weights.shape[1] <= 32
+    assert x.gemm2_permuted.ndim == 2 and x.gemm2_permuted.is_contiguous()
+    assert x.gemm2_permuted.shape[1] == hidden_size
+    expert_outputs = x.gemm2_permuted.view(*expert_weights.shape, hidden_size)
+    assert expert_outputs.dtype == residual.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+    assert expert_weights.dtype == torch.float32
+    for tensor in (expert_outputs, expert_weights, residual):
+        assert tensor.is_contiguous() and tensor.device == residual.device
+    for weight, eps in ((post_weight, post_eps), (next_weight, next_eps)):
+        if weight is not None:
+            assert eps is not None
+            assert weight.shape == (hidden_size,) and weight.is_contiguous()
+            assert weight.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and weight.device == residual.device
+    if strategy not in (None, "fused", "unfused"):
+        raise ValueError(f"Unknown local MegaMoE finalize strategy: {strategy}")
+    if strategy == "unfused":
+        from .layernorm import beam_norm_residual_norm
+
+        finalized = torch.empty_like(residual)
+        beam_moe_finalize(
+            expert_outputs,
+            expert_weights,
+            finalized,
+            routed_scale,
+            post_weight,
+            post_eps,
+        )
+        return beam_norm_residual_norm(
+            finalized, residual, None, None, next_weight, next_eps, scales
+        )
+    hidden = torch.empty_like(residual)
+    normalized = torch.empty_like(residual) if next_eps is not None else None
+    if tokens:
+        _module().beam_moe_finalize_norm_residual_norm(
+            expert_outputs,
+            expert_weights,
+            residual,
+            post_weight,
+            next_weight,
+            hidden,
+            normalized,
+            routed_scale,
+            post_eps or 0.0,
+            next_eps or 0.0,
+            *(scales if scales is not None else (1.0, 1.0)),
+            post_eps is not None,
+            next_eps is not None,
+            scales is not None,
+        )
+    return hidden, normalized

+"""Packed attention projections using shared low-latency GEMMs."""
+
+import functools
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+
+@functools.cache
+def _tinygemm():
+    from flashinfer.jit import gen_tinygemm2_module
+
+    return gen_tinygemm2_module().build_and_load()
+
+
+def use_low_latency_gemm(weight: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+    from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.cute_dsl.ll_bf16 import is_available
+
+    return (
+        weight.dtype == torch.bfloat16
+        and weight.device.type == "cuda"
+        and current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100)
+        and weight.shape in ((1792, 5120), (3584, 5120))
+        and is_available()
+    )
+
+
+def warmup_packed_projection(weight: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+    from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.cute_dsl.ll_bf16 import (
+        ll_bf16_gemm_c1_pdl_kernel,
+        ll_bf16_gemm_kernel,
+    )
+
+    shapes = [(weight.shape[1], weight.shape[0])]
+    ll_bf16_gemm_c1_pdl_kernel.warmup(
+        shapes=shapes, m_values=[1], output_dtype=torch.bfloat16
+    )
+    ll_bf16_gemm_kernel.warmup(
+        shapes=shapes, m_values=[2, 16], output_dtype=torch.bfloat16
+    )
+    _tinygemm()
+
+
+def packed_projection(
+    x: torch.Tensor, weight: torch.Tensor, low_latency: bool
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    rows = x.shape[0]
+    if not low_latency or not 1 <= rows <= 16 or not x.is_contiguous():
+        return F.linear(x, weight)
+    tiny_max = 8 if weight.shape[0] == 1792 else 4
+    if 3 <= rows <= tiny_max:
+        output = x.new_empty((rows, weight.shape[0]))
+        _tinygemm().tinygemm2_nobias_op(x, weight, output, False)
+        return output
+    from vllm.model_executor.kernels.linear.cute_dsl.ll_bf16 import ll_bf16_gemm
+
+    return ll_bf16_gemm(x, weight, output_dtype=torch.bfloat16)

+    "time": _TIME,
+    "date-time": f"{_DATE}T{_TIME}",
+    "email": (
+        rf"{_ATOM}(?:\.{_ATOM})*@[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9-]*[A-Za-z0-9])?"
+        r"(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]*[A-Za-z0-9])*"
+    ),
+    "hostname": rf"{_HOST_LABEL}(?:\.{_HOST_LABEL})*",
+    "ipv4": rf"(?:{_OCTET}\.){{3}}{_OCTET}",
+    "uuid": r"[0-9A-Fa-f]{8}(?:-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}){3}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{12}",
+    "uri": (
+        rf"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z+.-]*:(?://(?:(?:[{_URI_CHARS}:-]|{_ESCAPED})*@)?"
